v1.0.5.description:
# Clone Drone in the Danger Zone 1.0.5
## Item Placement
- New options in parameters "Steps items are step locked", it would help if you find the game difficult, but make the later game harder
- Useful items only appears one
- 70% of items would now be multiworld, instead of filler only
- Bow has less chance of spawning as first item of a randomized game
## Fillers
- Next Upgrade Free much commoner
- Start With Armor: Each gives you 3 spawn (fresh new run) with armor
- 60 seconds infinite armor: An armor that automatically respawn on damage. The 60 seconds unpause/start when the lift bring you in the arena (at the end) and pause when the lift bring you to the upgrade room (at the end). Having the effect active and winning a level gives you a free additional 8 seconds. It also restores back your original armor then.
## Steps
- Clone (All steps) has been added. It will be the only "All Steps" normal upgrade for now
- Shop Discount (Step X) has also been added, so it reduce the difficulty of the game if you fall on it.
## AI Usage and Misusage
- Corrected many bad pattern caused by AI
- Also reduce memory usage a lot (notably, a lot of int into byte)
- This only concern the patch, not the apworld


Read [README.md](https://github.com/adeko69/Clone_Drone_AP/blob/main/README.md) for more information
Reminder get both files
v1.0.5.title: AP-1.0.5

v1.1.description:
# Clone Drone in the Danger Zone AP - 1.1

## New Scenarios
- The game is too easy? Try the "Level Up" challenge, it will gets quickly harder
- The game is too hard? Try the "Easy Mode" challenge, this one reduce the level of every enemy. (Some level may force having a bow a reflect arrow level 3 to beat; im sorry about that)

## Reviewed Logic
- Potentially the last logic reviewed, now every upgrade should be obtainable and you will be able to have EVERY upgrade obtainable. 
- Old logic could generate 5 impossible items placement (Kick under Shield Bash; Energy capacity under AimTime notably), I had this in my list to thing to check in 1.0.5 and forgot until this morning lmao

## Options
- Reviewed Order of items, 
- +3 options (see new features)

## New Features
- Overpriced Shop: N upgrades gets their price 3 skillpoint more expensive. Get randomized every death.
- Price of a skillpoint: between 1 and 5, base 3 (old was already 3)
- Step Keys: You'll have the option to add progressive key to be able to continue in your goal. If you don't have it, you BK or you check EVERY SINGLE UPGRADE in your checks to validate it and then you can continue playing 

## AI Usage
- Reduced
- Corrected some bad pattern
- Still not the most optimal, like I said I'll do this for 2.0.1 which would be the entire update

v2.0.description:
# Clone Drone in the Danger Zone AP 2.0 - Scrap Update

## New Goal
- Scrap Collector: Commentatron wanted the human for entertainment, Analysis-Bot wanted violence, they'll get what they want in Scrap Collector. As you divert the commentator through violence, collect the Scrap to get ready to escape the Arena!
- In Scrap Mode, compatible with Step mode (Reach goal, not in Scrap Collector) killing various enemies give you scrap, but also combos opportunities, which increase even more the earned scrap.
- Three Scrap Requirement, depending on the time you want the AP to go (Option, time is estimated in MINIMUM SETTINGS): 100k (2 hours), 1 million (20 hours) and... 10 millions (200 hours)?!

## The Road to the 10 Million Scrap
- Ten. Million. Scrap. This is a lot of Scrap. Approximately minimum 200 hours of gameplay in minimal settings.
- Don't worry. If you have friends (which I don't have), you can try to beat the 10 Million Scrap Challenge Together. Coop Mode can also be activated if scrap mode is on. In Coop Mode, you select a percent of shared points (between 0, 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100%) and then, if not = 0%, every points you gain at the end of a round will be duplicated into the Coop pool
 
## Items
- All fillers can now accept a weight between 0 and 10 (Free Clone excepted). Just dont abuse it.
- Scrap Mode also have specific Fillers & Items. Activating them outside Scrap mode does nothing. 
- To help you through Scrap mode, "Scrap" and "Big Scrap" items also exists. They give you 500 and 5000 Scrap to help you with the Scrap Requirement. What are we building with all that scrap.
- Progressive Weapon, energy and Free Clone are now limited to 100 items (because now 1500 check game are possible, so it's a lot)
- Over 100 of the previous items or over 1100 items, a shit filler will complete the checks to avoid overflows

## Progressive Weapon Filler Item
- Weapon Enhancement Filler was nerfed for sword, boosted for hammer
- Clone not having Enhancement is now fixed
- Spear is now fast properly


Get Both Files
